semantics.policy: No selected direction, normative ride threshold, budget uplift or off-peak relaxation. Comparisons do not close the proposal.
semantics.quality: 54 separate nominal on-board ride dimensions: each of 27 nonhub sites to FS on the AM anchored pattern, from FS on the PM anchored pattern. Occurrences remain explicit. Excludes walking, waiting and rail residual wait; no empirical reliability or demand weighting. A direction cannot be chosen for every site independently on the same trip.
semantics.rail: Frozen 2026-09-03 targets only: five AM 07:26-09:26 and six PM through 19:32. Compared ready span ends 19:40, excludes original 20:32 target. Not current rail or approved peak phases.
semantics.resources: Minimum service km conditional on each assignment, four nominal vehicles and five-minute dispatch grid. Stress fleet reported separately. Extra direction constraints cannot lower the unrestricted optimum; lower km are not promised. Timeout is not infeasibility; no global road-network optimum.
semantics.scope: All 16 AM/PM west/east direction assignments on the four frozen corrected road patterns. Each retained train anchor must have a qualifying run of the assigned direction; other coverage runs may use either direction. This is not a fixed whole-day direction-switch timetable.
semantics.service: H30 common ready-time windows 06:50-08:50 and 16:35-18:35, all nine timing scenarios. H60 requested and H90 unapproved comparison kept separate. Fast last local boarding occurrences unchanged. All 28 site identities retained, not authorised platforms.
